prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Construction Industry Federation (CIF) members directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: CIF membership shows the company is recognised by the main representative body of the Irish construction sector.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the CIF members directory search and enter the company name in the keyword field.
prompts.found_when: A member listing for the company appears in the CIF directory, with its sector or division shown.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the CIF members directory returns no listing for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The members directory cannot be searched, the page is unreadable, or the trading name differs too much from the registered name to match.

prompts.question: Does this company have a member listing in the Cork Chamber of Commerce business directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A chamber listing shows the company is visible in the Munster business network and reaches regional buyers.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Cork Chamber member directory search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member profile page for the company appears in the Cork Chamber directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The member directory returns no profile for the company under a clean name search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search is unavailable, or the name matches several unrelated members so the right one cannot be confirmed.

prompts.question: Is this company named as a party in any written judgment on the Courts Service of Ireland judgments portal?
prompts.why_it_matters: Court judgments reveal commercial disputes, insolvency or contract litigation the company has been involved in.

source.name: Courts Service of Ireland - Judgments Portal

prompts.how_to_query: Open the judgments portal search, enter the company name and run a title search.
prompts.found_when: One or more published judgments list the company as a party or name it in the ruling.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean title search returns no judgment naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The judgments search is unavailable, or the name is too common to separate the company from similarly named parties.

prompts.question: Is this company listed among the authorised energy suppliers published by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities (CRU)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only suppliers on the CRU list may lawfully sell electricity or gas to Irish customers.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the CRU energy suppliers in Ireland page and scan the list of authorised suppliers for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company name appears in the CRU list of authorised electricity or gas suppliers.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean scan of the published supplier lists shows no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The supplier lists cannot be loaded or clearly read, or it is unclear whether the entity supplies energy at all.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in any Data Protection Commission (DPC) decision, inquiry finding or enforcement notice?
prompts.why_it_matters: A DPC decision shows the data regulator has found problems with how the company handles personal data.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the search box on the DPC website and enter the company name to look for decisions and inquiry findings.
prompts.found_when: A DPC decision, inquiry finding, fine or corrective order naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean site search returns no DPC decision or enforcement material naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search fails or returns too many unrelated hits for a common name to attribute any decision confidently.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Dublin Chamber of Commerce member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A Dublin Chamber listing signals the company is part of the largest business network in the Greater Dublin Area.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Dublin Chamber member directory and search for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member entry or profile for the company is shown in the Dublin Chamber directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory returns no member entry for the company after a clean name search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory cannot be searched or loaded, or the name returns only unrelated listings.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a client company in the Enterprise Ireland company directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Enterprise Ireland client status shows the company is recognised and supported as an Irish exporting business.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the search on the Enterprise Ireland site and enter the company name to find its client profile.
prompts.found_when: A client company profile or entry for the company appears on the Enterprise Ireland site.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no client profile or entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search is unavailable, or results are too generic to confirm whether the company is an Enterprise Ireland client.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Department of Enterprise, Trade and Employment employment permits issued to companies register?
prompts.why_it_matters: The permits list shows how heavily the company relies on non-EEA hires, which sharpens questions about staffing and local jobs claims.

prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the published file shows no permit record under the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The published file cannot be downloaded or opened, or the name is abbreviated in the data so that a match cannot be confirmed.

prompts.question: Does this company hold an industrial emissions, IPC or waste licence recorded in the EPA Licensing and LEAP online system?

prompts.not_found_when: A clean licence search returns no licence record under the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The LEAP search is unavailable, or the company trades under a site name that cannot be linked to the legal entity.

prompts.question: Does this company appear as applicant or party in any planning application on the ePlanning national planning search?

prompts.found_when: One or more planning application files list the company as applicant or party.

prompts.couldnt_check_when: The ePlanning portal for the relevant authority is unreachable, or planning files name individuals rather than the company so no match is possible.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the German-Irish Chamber of Industry and Commerce member directory?

prompts.question: Is this company a listed member of the Guaranteed Irish certification network?

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the High Court Search registry of proceedings, winding-up petitions or listed cases?

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Irish Hotels Federation (IHF) member or supplier directory?

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a full member of the Irish Venture Capital Association (IVCA)?

prompts.question: Is this company currently advertising job vacancies on JobAlert.ie?
